title: Build fails on MacOS
body:
### Describe the bug

```
[2/123] Building C object src/nvim/CMakeFiles/nvim.dir/lua/spell.c.o
FAILED: src/nvim/CMakeFiles/nvim.dir/lua/spell.c.o 
/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/bin/cc -DINCLUDE_GENERATED_DECLARATIONS -DMIN_LOG_LEVEL=3 -DNVIM_MSGPACK_HAS_FLOAT32 -DNVIM_TS_HAS_SET_ALLOCATOR -DNVIM_TS_HAS_SET_MATCH_LIMIT -DNVIM_UNIBI_HAS_VAR_FROM -Dnvim_EXPORTS -I/Users/<user>/usr/src/neovim/build/src/nvim/auto -I/Users/<user>/usr/src/neovim/build/include -I/Users/<user>/usr/src/neovim/build/cmake.config -I/Users/<user>/usr/src/neovim/src -isystem /Users/<user>/usr/src/neovim/.deps/usr/include -isystem /opt/local/include -isystem /Users/<user>/usr/src/neovim/.deps/usr/include/luajit-2.1 -U_FORTIFY_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=1 -O2 -DNDEBUG -flto=thin -isysroot /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX13.1.sdk -mmacosx-version-min=13.0 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Wno-unused-parameter -Wstrict-prototypes -std=gnu99 -Wshadow -Wconversion -Wdouble-promotion -Wmissing-noreturn -Wmissing-format-attribute -Wmissing-prototypes -Wimplicit-fallthrough -Wvla -fno-common -fdiagnostics-color=always -fstack-protector-strong -MD -MT src/nvim/CMakeFiles/nvim.dir/lua/spell.c.o -MF src/nvim/CMakeFiles/nvim.dir/lua/spell.c.o.d -o src/nvim/CMakeFiles/nvim.dir/lua/spell.c.o -c /Users/<user>/usr/src/neovim/src/nvim/lua/spell.c
/Users/<user>/usr/src/neovim/src/nvim/lua/spell.c:109:3: error: implicit declaration of function 'luaL_register' is invalid in C99 [-Werror,-Wimplicit-function-declaration]
  luaL_register(L, NULL, spell_functions);
  ^
...
```
All errors are due to `implicit declaration`s.

### Steps to reproduce

```bash
git clone 'neovim/neovim' && cd neovim
make CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && make CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$HOME/usr/local/nvim install
```

### Expected behavior

compilation succeeds

### Neovim version (nvim -v)

commit 93d99aefd314bc4abfc54c0c29a4de84b6fcc823

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

n.a.

### Operating system/version

macOS 13

### Terminal name/version

kitty

### $TERM environment variable

xterm-kitty

### Installation

source

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
I don't want to wait too long before merging the PR, but I'm hesitant to include it before having *some* idea why it's needed and why the current implementation fails for you and works for others. We'd just be postponing the real work to future contributors when they inevitably start wondering why the `SYSTEM` keyword is needed (or worse, if they accidentally add the `SYSTEM` keyword in a future refactor).

I don't see a valid reason why `SYSTEM` shouldn't work; in fact, it makes more sense to use `SYSTEM` since we don't want compiler warnings from lua or luajit.

As I understand it, the only difference between your system and other mac users is that you use macports? I'm not familiar with mac ecosystem, but would it be feasible to try with homebrew instead of macports and see if that is what's causing this? That way we'd have some clue as to what's going on and how we can prevent this in the future.
